scope: read-only official-v15/H2/S1-C1 evidence investigation; no candidate, device, or flash action
summary: Official v15 exposes memcpy and stock product SysEx delegation, but no verified callable helper set for exact private length/framing, seven-bit field decode, CRC-16 packet/set validation, two-slot bounded note checks, or ARMED-last atomic publication. A tiny trampoline alone cannot implement S1-C2 safely.

required_capability_results.reason: The completed-message caller passes r0=assembled message and r1=accumulated length to 0x0201e254. This is not a callable private parser helper.
The assembler threshold and stock Yamaha paths check their own product states. The direct path copies r9-6 before checking only final F7; it does not enforce private 173/176-byte exact lengths.
Official framing is inline in the product handler for F0 43 and single-parameter traffic. It is not a parameterized callable helper for F0 7D 53 4D 4B 0F 01.
Only inline product-specific 14-bit index reconstruction and factory packed-record expansion were found. Neither decodes arbitrary private LEN/CRC fields into caller-owned state.
memcpy/memmove-style helper has the established scalar ABI r0=dst, r1=src, r2=len and is called from stock loaders and consumers.
No verified callable CRC-16/CCITT helper is identified. Deterministic listing scans find no 0x1021, 0x8408, or 0xa001 constants, and the direct Yamaha path does not prove a checksum gate.
Factory loader bounds bank <=3 and preset <=31 using globals; single-parameter writer truncates an address to u8. No callable helper validates NOTE0/NOTE1 0..127 and distinct.

The H2 producer has a one-slot nonblocking lock/copy/valid-last sequence for accepted product SysEx. It has no note fields, no slot1, no transaction ID, no LOADING/ARMED state, and cannot be sequenced into all-or-none two-slot publication.

required_capability_results.capability: unchanged delegation to stock product SysEx
required_capability_results.reason: A trampoline can tail-call the exact preserved handler with original r0/r1 for non-private traffic. This does not solve private parser/helper absence.

code_budget.maximum_reusable_free_budget_if_h2_produ: 108 bytes total non-contiguous/local tail budget, before any trampoline body constraints
code_budget.finding: Only memcpy and tail delegation are reusable helpers, so exact prefix, length, 7-bit, two CRC loops, distinct-note checks, two-slot copy, lock rechecks, reject paths, and ARMED-last state still require new parser/publication code exceeding the proven tiny-trampoline route.

negative_scans.stock_checksum_gate_for_live_163_packet: not proven; S1-C1 ingress showed live R02 payload does not satisfy assumed Yamaha sum-to-zero
